utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Cleo, I’m coming in a little late, but Rosa said the repair drive’s Sunday at the community center now—do you know the latest details?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s the latest I’ve heard too—Rosa’s coordinating the schedule, and I’ve got the tape, markers, and boxes ready at the community shed; I’m still checking on screws and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, thanks — I’ll help spread that it’s Sunday at the community center, and let me know once you hear about the screws and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Uli, the latest I have is to send everyone to Maple Street first for the fence panels, and I can update you if Sam says the next crew needs to shift.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal. I’ll head to Maple Street with a few basic tools and help for a bit, but I may need to leave early.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That works, Uli—Maple Street is still the first stop, so just start on the fence panels and I’ll let you know if Sam sends us anywhere else.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Nell, do you know anyone who’s actually confirmed for this weekend, or should I ask Mara again for a straight count and a supplies list?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’d ask Mara again, honestly—I’m still only hearing things second-hand, and Jules might have the clearest count if Mara doesn’t.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, I’ll ask Mara for the actual count and a proper supplies list—if you hear anything firm from Jules, send it straight to me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: If you can make it, bring the toolbox, but we’re still telling folks to cover tape, screws, and gloves just in case.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—still on, then. I’ll try to bring the toolbox over, and if I forget again at least folks have the tape and screws covered.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, that works—bring it if you can, and we’ll keep tape, screws, and gloves covered either way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out running errands, but I’m tracking it—if it turns urgent, text me and I’ll head to the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good to know, Ira—I’ll text if anything turns urgent; for now I’m just collecting firm confirms and any tool or spare-part gaps for Mara and Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Tess—send me the firm count and any gaps once you’ve got them, and if you get short on hands I can head over.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in for the van brakes first, but I still need Opal to lock in the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem—I’ll still swing by around nine with my ladder, drill, and tool kit, so we’ve got a solid backup once Opal confirms.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—if Opal confirms around then, let’s start with the van brakes and go from there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Mostly small fixes, I think—chairs, lamps, and little household stuff like that, and if I remember right Vik’s helping keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that matches what I’ve heard so far; I’m trying not to repeat anything firmer until Rosa confirms the details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, that sounds smart—I’m a bit fuzzy on the exact details too, but it should be the usual small household repairs, and Vik’s the one keeping things moving.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Faye, I’ve got you penciled in for midday check-in, and I’ll keep Maple Street as the fallback if they still need an extra hand then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me, Mara—midday between drop-off and pickup is perfect, and Maple Street as a fallback sounds good.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Faye—I’ll keep you on midday check-in and only shift you to Maple Street if Sam says they still need the extra help then.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Rosa, can we confirm the date and location first, and do we have a clear yes-or-no yet on who’s bringing the screws and gloves?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’m still waiting on a firm yes-or-no about the screws and gloves, so please send me any confirms as soon as you hear them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sunday at the community center helps, but I’m still uneasy until we have a firm name on screws and gloves, so let’s not assume they’re covered yet.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word, Sam—I’m just waiting on Opal and Mara to confirm the date, place, and repair list so I don’t send people the wrong details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules—I’ve heard it’s Sunday at the community center, but Opal’s still the one to confirm the start time and repair list, so let’s check with her before you send anything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That makes sense—I’ll hold off on pulling folks in until Opal confirms the start time and repair list, and then I can help connect the different groups fast.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Kira, let’s keep it simple: Gus is set for around nine with the ladder and drill, and we’ll start with the small fixes once the list is in order.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm who’s actually organizing it and whether the start is definitely 10, not around nine?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m organizing it, and Gus is coming by around nine so we can get set up, but the repair drive itself starts at ten.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hana, we could really use a few more hands at the repair drive—if you can stop by and help out, I’d appreciate it, and feel free to spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m happy to help once I have the basics straight—can you confirm the date, exact location, and what repairs the drive is actually covering?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep—it’s at 10 this Saturday at the community shed, and we’re covering small fixes like bikes, lamps, and basic household repairs; if that works for you, I’d love the help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sam, before we spread the word, can you confirm the date, the exact spot by the shed, and whether the van brake work is actually part of the repair drive or just the small fixes?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s Sunday at the community center, and I’d check with Opal for the exact spot by the shed and whether the van brake job’s included—I’m ready to help once she confirms.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam—that helps; let’s hold off on sharing it until Opal confirms the exact spot by the shed and whether the van brakes are actually included.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Faye, what’s actually confirmed for this weekend—how many people, and do we still need supplies more than tools?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I only know it was moved to Sunday at the community center, and I still need Hana or Jules to confirm the headcount and what supplies we need most before I plan around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, but can you at least tell me if you’re available Sunday and whether you can bring any basic supplies, so I’ve got one firm commitment to work with?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll try to stop by for a bit and help where I can, but I can’t stay long.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—thanks, Uli. Even a short stop helps, and I’ll try to get the toolbox over there once I get myself sorted.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. If I make it over, I’ll just keep to the simple jobs for a little while.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — head to the community shed and I’ll put you on the boxes for sorting; I’m just still checking whether we’ve got enough screws and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—community shed, got it; I can help sort boxes, though I’m still not certain if the start time was 10 and not 9.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rosa’s still confirming the start time tonight, so just come to the community shed and I’ll get you started on the boxes when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Jules, I’m telling everyone about the repair drive—want to come by and help out, and maybe spread the word too?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’m happy to help and pull folks in from a few different circles; I’m just waiting on Opal’s confirmed date, place, and repair list so I don’t spread mixed details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Jules—I’m organizing it, and as soon as Opal confirms the date, place, and repair list, I’ll send you the exact details so you can spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Dane, I’m helping Mara gather firm confirms and any tool or spare-part gaps for the repair drive, so if you know who’s definitely in or what we still need, pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, Tess, I came in late too—Rosa only told me it’s Sunday at the community center, so I don’t have the firm confirms or parts list yet.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No worries, Dane—if you hear who’s definitely coming or what tools we’re short on, send me a note and I’ll pass it to Mara.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m glad the tape’s sorted, but I still don’t want us assuming Noah covers the rest—can we pin down the date and place with Rosa and confirm who’s bringing screws and gloves?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes—let’s keep the shed as the plan unless Rosa says otherwise, and we should get someone besides Noah to confirm screws and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, that’s safer—I’d feel better once Rosa confirms the shed, the timing, and exactly who’s covering screws and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Rey, the latest I have is Sunday at the community center, with the crew heading to the Maple Street fence panels first unless Sam shifts things.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal—I’d still check that with Rosa before I pass it on, since the last solid word I had was around nine by the shed and mostly small fixes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good catch—I’m still tracking Sunday at the community center with Maple Street first, but I’ll confirm with Rosa before I send anyone your way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s about where I’m at too—I’ve only been hearing second-hand that it’s still on this weekend. If you’ve talked to Jules or Sam, they probably know more than I do.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, what I’ve been repeating is that the repair drive’s still on and we’re meeting by the community shed, but firm confirms and supplies are still a little up in the air.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That matches what I’d heard, so thanks—I’m still mostly going off second-hand updates too. If Jules or Sam firm up the timing or supplies, would you let me know?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli — quick update, the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center; if you’ve heard who still needs help or who’s confirmed, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rosa — I’ve got Gus confirmed with his ladder and drill, and Rey’s helping keep the list in order; I’ll send Hana and Ira your way and let them know it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thanks, Eli — Gus and Rey are a big help, and I appreciate you sending Hana and Ira my way and helping spread the update.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Still no firm update on the repair drive from what I’ve heard—Rosa’s organizing and the plan being repeated is to meet by the community shed. If anything gets confirmed or urgent, text me and I’ll head over.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you double-check that for me, Ira—I've heard Quinn and Mara are organizing it, and I still need the exact start time confirmed as 10, not 9, before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can’t confirm Quinn and Mara—I’ve only heard that Rosa’s organizing it, and I still don’t have a firm start time yet. If I get a confirmed 10 o’clock, I’ll text you right away.
